protocol.seed_pairing: same initialization, minibatch order, corruptions and torch random seeds per epoch
protocol.corruption: 10% random byte insertions cropped or deletions padded to original length; light Gaussian noise
protocol.selection: validation recovery with clean tolerance 0.010; held-out test not used for selection
protocol.metric: position accuracy compares against original at original indices; edit similarity uses Levenshtein realignment
protocol.warning: Fixed-length denoising cannot infer missing random bytes; alignment loss itself is training-only. Experiment is synthetic.

no_alignment_retrained.selection: best validation mean insert/delete recovery among clean-tolerance-eligible epochs

soft_dtw_retrained.selection: best validation mean insert/delete recovery among clean-tolerance-eligible epochs
